title: Bruce Maccabee judged the ARV photographs hoaxes

tellings.quote: I don't remember Bruce mcabe looked at them I know Bruce mcabe had only said um they definitely looked like hoaxes to him

plain: Photos said to show ARVs, short for 'alien reproduction vehicles', human-built copies of alien craft, were judged likely hoaxes by Bruce Maccabee, a physicist who studied UFO photos. The physicist Eric W. Davis says this in 2024, recalling that Maccabee told him the pictures 'definitely looked like hoaxes'. It counts against the photos as proof of such craft.
